summary: 63-year-old male hiker dislocated his ankle on the Hessie Trail after stepping off a large step; Nederland Fire and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group provided field care and carried him by litter to the Hessie trailhead; AMR transported him to a Boulder-area hospital; ~3.5-hour rescue.
